newsitem.title: USA: WinStar, U S WEST enter Wash. pact.
newsitem.headline: WinStar, U S WEST enter Wash. pact.

text.p: WinStar Communications Inc said Tuesday it has signed an interconnect agreement with U S WEST Inc's U S WEST Communications Group covering the state of Washington, where U S WEST is the main local telephone service provider.

WinStar plans to provide competitive telecommunications services in the Seattle, Spokane, and Tacoma markets beginning in 1998, the company said. This agreement establishes the terms under which WinStar and U S WEST will interconnect their networks, WinStar said.
WinStar now has interconnection agreements with all seven Regional Bell Operating Companies, GTE Corp, Sprint, and Southern New England Telecommunications Corp .
The agreements cover 27 of the major markets where WinStar aims to introduce its competitive local telephone business over the next three years, WinStar said.
